slides.title: Belly in isn't tight.
slides.body: Pulling your stomach in takes away the pressure that holds your spine still. Less pressure, less support under the bar.

slides.title: Breathe into your belt line.
slides.body: Big breath into your belly, sides and lower back. Then tighten around it like someone's about to poke you.

slides.title: Brace before you move.
slides.body: Breathe and brace standing tall, then start the rep. Bracing halfway down is already too late.

slides.title: One breath per rep.
slides.body: Reset your air and your brace at the top of every heavy rep. Three reps on one breath makes rep three soft.

slides.title: A belt is a wall, not a brace.
slides.body: It gives your brace something to push against. No brace, and it's just an expensive accessory.
